provenance.source_status: Base release plus uncommitted experimental evaluator and frozen workflow fixtures; exact source-file hashes below.

inputs.fixture_metadata: Evaluator split/family fields are attached from the frozen manifest; state, expected labels and profile requests are unchanged. Raw-file hashes remain recorded separately.

execution.latency_boundary: Each evaluator case measures local client + owned loopback gateway + provider discovery and inference + response validation; excludes deployment, build, bundling, input validation, gateway startup and deterministic baseline calculation.
execution.region_note: vercel_region is the build runtime environment value when supplied; null means unavailable, not inferred from project configuration.
execution.report_note: Actual model submissions are provider_model_posts. Evaluator attempted can also include a subsequent local abort after an error. No source state, questions, raw provider bodies or credentials are included.

limitations: 48 authored examples total, including 24 development examples and 24 screening examples. The screening set is small and synthetic, not a population-quality benchmark.
The screening author saw the rubrics and development cases. Independent authoring and distinct fictional source families do not provide blind population sampling.

Each workflow has eight screening cases. Accuracy describes these cases only; it does not establish calibration, workflow time saved, correction effort, source-location recall, or real-task effectiveness.
Relevance labels assess coverage, not truth or source reliability. All excerpts remain available to the caller.
The literal claim baseline is deliberately weak and may accept quoted claims or miss contradictions. A model outperforming it is not sufficient evidence of practical value.
After any predictions are inspected, preserve these files and report revisions as new experiments instead of tuning this screening set.
